entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling because I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF778-09B. The name on the order is Sam Jones.

Thank you, Sam. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered about 65 days ago. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?

It's more about the fit. I spent a lot of time getting the cleats adjusted perfectly, but after a few long rides, they're just giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They seem like great shoes, but they're not working for my feet.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. Fit is incredibly important. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery was 65 days ago, and our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days. So, you are definitely eligible for a full refund.
That's great to hear. I appreciate you making that easy.
Of course. I can email you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will process the full refund to your original payment method.

Perfect. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of trying them out and now have to repackage everything, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase? I'm planning to buy a different pair of shoes from your site.

I understand the request, and I'm glad you're planning to stick with VeloFit for your next pair. While our policy allows for the full refund, I'm not able to add a promotional discount on top of the return. However, I can get this return label sent to you immediately so you can get your refund processed as quickly as possible.
Okay, that's fair. The refund is the most important part. Please go ahead and send the label.
I've just sent it to the email on file. You should see it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
